text: DSH Russian language pack（DSH 插件，Web 客户端）：为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面添加俄语。它向 DSH 客户端 locale 服务注册“Русский”语言及俄语字典，并以英语作为未翻译内容的回退语言。用户可在语言选择器中启用俄语界面，适合希望用俄语阅读和操作 DSH 网页界面的用户。代码未显示需要 API 密钥或外部服务。

DSH Russian language pack adds Russian to the DSH web interface. It registers “Русский” and translations with the locale service; untranslated text falls back to English. Users select Russian in the language selector. No API key or external service is shown in the inspected code.
想把 DSH 网页界面切换成俄语。
有没有能给 DeepSeek Harness 添加俄语菜单和界面文字的语言包？
How can I use the DSH web interface in Russian?
DSH Russian language pack 的功能「俄语界面」：向 DSH 的 locale 服务注册 Русский 语言和俄语翻译字典，并将英语设为回退语言。启用插件后，用户可在 DSH 语言选择器中选择俄语。

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · DSH Russian language pack：Russian (Русский) for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
web GUI. It registers a language with the shipped locale service, so it appears
in the **native** language selector — **Settings → General → Language** — next to
the built-in English and 中文.

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · DSH Russian language pack：- **2310 strings** translated across **55 namespaces** — chat, the whole settings
  tree, the plugin pages, tool calls, approvals, usage statistics, the command
  palette.
- **Fallback chain `ru → en`**: anything not translated yet is shown in English,
  never as a raw key.
- **No build step and no dependencies** for the user: `client.js` is plain
  JavaScript that DSH evaluates as-is. Node is only needed to run the installer.
@local/dsh-locale-ru README · Install：Requires DeepSeek Harness Desktop (or `dsh web`) with a managed profile.

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · The short way：```bash
git clone git@github.com:mrtoxiorg-sys/dsh-locale-ru.git
cd dsh-locale-ru
node install-locale-ru.mjs
```

The installer mirrors the package into `<profile>/node_modules/@local` and
registers it in the profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`. It is idempotent and takes
`--check` and `--uninstall`:

```
$ node install-locale-ru.mjs --check
profile        : /home/you/.dsh/profiles/desktop
language       : ru (Русский), fallback en
registered     : yes

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · Where is my profile?：The installer resolves it the way `dsh` does:

| Environment | Profile directory |
| --- | --- |
| `DSH_PROFILE_DIR` | that path, verbatim |
| `DSH_HOME` + `DSH_PROFILE` | `$DSH_HOME/profiles/$DSH_PROFILE` |
| neither | `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop` |

So a non-default profile is one variable away:

```bash
DSH_PROFILE_DIR="$HOME/.dsh/profiles/work" node install-locale-ru.mjs
```

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · Uninstall：```bash
node install-locale-ru.mjs --uninstall
```

Removes the bundle entry and the mirrored package; the language disappears from
the selector on the next reload. Or by hand: drop `@local/dsh-locale-ru` from
`bundles` and from `dependencies`, then delete
`<profile>/node_modules/@local/dsh-locale-ru`.

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · If the application refuses to start：A client plugin that throws while activating fails the *whole* web boot. The
desktop shell then offers **Disable third-party plugins, back up profile patch,
and restart** — that recovery also drops this bundle from
`dsh.profile.bundles`, which is the state `--check` reports as
`registered: no`. Re-running the installer puts it back.

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · How it works：DSH ships a locale service (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-locale`) that hard-codes
`en` and `zh` but publicly supports external language packs:

```js
ctx.locale.addLanguage({ id: 'ru', label: 'Русский', fallback: 'en' })
ctx.locale.register('<namespace>', 'ru', { '<key>': '<перевод>' })
```

This package is exactly such a pack, and nothing more:

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · How it works：| File | Role |
| --- | --- |
| `client.js` | **Generated.** Registers the language and one dictionary per namespace, as owned effects |
| `index.js` | Host half, deliberately empty: the loader row only has to exist |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Inserts the `locale-ru` row into the profile composition |
| `package.json` | Declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and the `dsh.client` browser half |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/ru.json` | Title and description for the Plugins page |

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · How it works：The language is registered as an effect, so unloading the plugin removes it from
the selector and returns an active selection to the browser default.

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · Updating translations：`client.js` is never edited by hand — it is rendered from the translation
chunks. `build/dicts.json` is a snapshot of the English and Chinese dictionaries
extracted from the DSH client bundles, and is the source of truth for the key
set.

```bash

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · 1. Re-extract the dictionaries from a DSH installation (after a DSH update)：node build/asar-extract-re.mjs \
  "/path/to/DeepSeek Harness/resources/app.asar" /tmp/dsh-bundles \
  'dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-[^/]+/lib/(client|index)\.js$'
node build/extract-dicts.mjs /tmp/dsh-bundles build/dicts.json
section: 1. Re-extract the dictionaries from a DSH installation (after a DSH update)

text: @local/dsh-locale-ru README · 2. Re-split into balanced translation jobs：node build/make-tasks.mjs build/dicts.json build/tasks

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · 4. Render client.js and check everything：node build/build-client.mjs build/dicts.json build/ru .
node verify-locale-ru.mjs
```

`build/build-client.mjs` refuses to write when a key is missing and dumps the
missing rows into `build/missing.json` in a shape a translator can work with
directly. The extraction works on the *built* bundles, so after a DSH update the
pipeline is re-run rather than patched.

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · Verification：`verify-locale-ru.mjs` is dependency-free and runs in CI on every push. It
performs four independent checks:

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · Verification：1. **Coverage** — every English key has a Russian string, nothing invented.
2. **Placeholders** — every `{name}` survives with the same name.
3. **Drift** — the committed `client.js` is byte-for-byte what `build/ru` renders.
4. **Runtime contract** — the bundle is evaluated inside a two-line
   `window.__ModuleLoader__` stub and must register `ru` / `Русский` / fallback
   `en` plus one dictionary per namespace, matching `build/ru` exactly.
@local/dsh-locale-ru README · License：MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE).

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · Русский：Языковой пакет для веб-интерфейса DeepSeek Harness. Добавляет русский язык в
штатный переключатель **Settings → General → Language** и переводит интерфейс:
2310 строк в 55 неймспейсах. Цепочка фолбэка `ru → en` — непереведённая строка
показывается по-английски, ничего не ломается.

```bash
git clone git@github.com:mrtoxiorg-sys/dsh-locale-ru.git
cd dsh-locale-ru
node install-locale-ru.mjs          # поставить
node install-locale-ru.mjs --check  # проверить состояние

@local/dsh-locale-ru README · Русский：Профиль ищется так же, как его ищет `dsh`: `DSH_PROFILE_DIR`, иначе
`$DSH_HOME/profiles/$DSH_PROFILE`, иначе `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`. После
установки — перезагрузка страницы.

Правка переводов: `build/ru/task-*.json` → `node build/build-client.mjs build/dicts.json build/ru .`
→ `node install-locale-ru.mjs` → перезагрузка страницы. Полные правила перевода —
в [build/TRANSLATION-BRIEF.md](build/TRANSLATION-BRIEF.md).
